title: List stamphog review runs
description: List stamphog's automated review runs for pull requests in this project, newest first. Filter by `repository`, `pr_number`, or `status` to find why a specific PR got its verdict. Leave `trigger` unset unless you want one trigger only: `trigger: all` does not mean every trigger. Each run reports its lifecycle `status`, final `verdict`, and the deterministic gate outcome (`gate_result`) computed before the reviewer ran. The reviewer's reasoning is null in list results — use `stamphog-review-runs-get` on a run to read it.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription: Filter by what caused the run. Leave it unset to include runs from every trigger. 'all' is not a wildcard: it matches only runs in repos that review every pull request event. The other values: 'label' (the repo's trigger label opted the PR in), 'manual' (someone requested the review through the API or MCP), and 'self_driving' (stamphog reviewed a bot-authored PR from the inbox).

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
Allowlisted, content-free slice of ``ReviewRun.gate_result``.

The raw gate blob nests ``gates``, ``classification``, and ``policy`` sub-objects that carry
repository content — changed-file paths (``safe_migration_files``, ``invalid_folder_files``),
manifest gate messages, and declared ``policy.scopes`` — which a project member without repo
access must not read. Only the terminal decision is exposed.

typeDocumentation.effectiveDescription:
What caused this run to exist: self-driving inbox provenance, a manual request through the API, the repo's trigger label, or the repo reviewing every PR event.

* `self_driving` - SELF_DRIVING
* `manual` - MANUAL
* `label` - LABEL
* `all` - ALL
